metadata.title: Campaign Promise Tracker
metadata.platformTitle: Canada Strong - Unite. Secure. Protect. Build.
metadata.reviewPolicy: Status changes require a pull request with cited official evidence from the platform, LEGISinfo, Budget documents, or Public Accounts.
metadata.curationNote: Human-reviewable data file. Promise text is a short commitment label backed by the cited platform location; status evidence is limited to official government or parliamentary records.

commitments.promise: Create a single-window Major Projects Office for nation-building projects.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 says the Major Projects Office launched on August 29, 2025 and proposes operating funding.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 1 - Launching the Major Projects Office
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 states that the Major Projects Office launched on August 29, 2025 and proposes $213.8 million over five years.

commitments.promise: Move federal project reviews toward One Project, One Review agreements.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 describes the Throne Speech commitment, first ministers' agreement, and cooperation-agreement pathway.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 1 - One Project, One Review
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 describes work toward cooperation agreements under the Impact Assessment Act.

commitments.promise: Expand the Indigenous Loan Guarantee Program for major projects.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 states the program was doubled from $5 billion to $10 billion.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 1 - One Project, One Review
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 says the Indigenous Loan Guarantee Program was doubled from $5 billion to $10 billion.

commitments.promise: Use federal financing tools to unlock nation-building projects.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 announces intent to raise the Canada Infrastructure Bank envelope from $35 billion to $45 billion.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 1 - Boosting Major Project Financing
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 announces intent to amend the Canada Infrastructure Bank Act to increase the statutory capital envelope.

commitments.promise: Build high-speed rail between Windsor and Quebec City.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 identifies Alto High-Speed Rail as a transformative strategy and says the MPO will accelerate engineering, regulatory, and permitting work.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 1 - Nation-Building Projects and Strategies
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 lists Alto High-Speed Rail and says the MPO will work to accelerate pre-construction work.

commitments.promise: Launch Build Canada Homes to build and finance affordable housing at scale.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 says Build Canada Homes launched, with a $13 billion initial investment and first initiatives.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 3 - Launching Build Canada Homes
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 states Build Canada Homes launched on September 14, 2025 with an initial $13 billion investment.

commitments.promise: Remove or reduce GST for first-time buyers of new homes up to $1.5 million.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 says the measure is before Parliament as part of Bill C-4.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 3 - Eliminating the GST for First-Time Home Buyers
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 says the first-time home buyer GST measure is before Parliament as part of Bill C-4.

commitments.promise: Reduce the first federal personal income tax bracket from 15 percent to 14 percent.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 says Canadians have paid less tax since July 1, 2025 and the rate reduction is before Parliament as part of Bill C-4.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 3 - Middle-Class Tax Cut
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 states the first bracket was lowered to 14 percent and the measure is before Parliament in Bill C-4.

commitments.promise: Cancel the consumer fuel charge and remove consumer-facing carbon price requirements.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 says the consumer fuel charge was cancelled as of April 1, 2025 and permanent legislative removal is before Parliament in Bill C-4.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 3 - Cancelling the Divisive Consumer Carbon Price
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 says the consumer fuel charge was cancelled and legislative removal is before Parliament as part of Bill C-4.

commitments.promise: Start Automatic Federal Benefits for lower-income Canadians.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 says Automatic Federal Benefits will start for the 2026 tax year and proposes CRA implementation funding.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 3 - Delivering Automatic Federal Benefits
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 proposes Income Tax Act amendments and $71 million over five years for CRA implementation.

commitments.promise: Make the National School Food Program permanent.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 proposes legislation and ongoing annual funding starting in 2029-30.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 3 - Making the National School Food Program Permanent
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 proposes legislation and $216.6 million per year starting in 2029-30 to make the program permanent.

commitments.promise: Lower barriers to access the Canada Disability Benefit.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 proposes funding to offset Disability Tax Credit certification costs for Canada Disability Benefit recipients.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 3 - Lowering Barriers to Access the Canada Disability Benefit
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 proposes $115.7 million over four years and ongoing funding for a supplemental payment tied to DTC certification.

commitments.promise: Introduce a Canada Strong Pass for museums, parks, galleries, and VIA Rail discounts.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 says the summer pass was introduced and proposes renewal for the holiday season and summer 2026.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 3 - Renewing the Canada Strong Pass
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 says the pass was introduced in summer 2025 and proposes renewal funding.

commitments.promise: Strengthen CBC/Radio-Canada mandate and funding.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 proposes one-year funding and mandate modernization work; statutory long-term funding is not shown as complete.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 3 - Protecting Our National Broadcaster
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 proposes $150 million in 2025-26 and says the government will explore modernising CBC/Radio-Canada's mandate.

commitments.promise: Increase the SR&ED enhanced expenditure limit to $6 million and reform administration.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 proposes the $6 million limit and confirms SR&ED administration reforms.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 1 - Enhancing SR&ED Tax Incentives
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 proposes increasing the enhanced SR&ED expenditure limit from $4.5 million to $6 million.

commitments.promise: Recapitalize venture capital support with a $1 billion initiative.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 proposes $1 billion for BDC to launch the Venture and Growth Capital Catalyst Initiative.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 1 - Investing to Build High-Growth Companies
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 proposes $1 billion over three years for BDC to launch the Venture and Growth Capital Catalyst Initiative.

commitments.promise: Catalyze AI infrastructure and sovereign compute capacity.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 provides $925.6 million over five years for large-scale sovereign AI compute capacity.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 1 - AI and Quantum
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 provides $925.6 million over five years for large-scale sovereign compute capacity.

commitments.promise: Create a Critical Minerals Sovereign Fund for strategic projects and companies.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 proposes $2 billion over five years to create the fund.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 1 - Supporting Critical Mineral Projects
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 proposes $2 billion over five years to create the Critical Minerals Sovereign Fund.

commitments.promise: Create a First and Last Mile Fund for critical minerals supply chains.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 proposes $371.8 million over four years and up to $1.5 billion in support through 2029-30.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 1 - Supporting Critical Mineral Projects
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 proposes funding to create the First and Last Mile Fund for upstream and midstream critical minerals projects.

commitments.promise: Expand critical mineral exploration tax-credit eligibility.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 proposes adding 12 critical minerals to the Critical Mineral Exploration Tax Credit.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 1 - Supporting Critical Mineral Projects
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 proposes expanding CMETC eligibility to 12 additional critical minerals.

commitments.promise: Proceed with the Clean Electricity investment tax credit.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 confirms intent to proceed and proposes removing conditions on Crown-corporation eligibility.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 1 - Clean Economy Investment Tax Credits
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 confirms intent to proceed with the Clean Electricity investment tax credit.

commitments.promise: Extend full CCUS investment tax credit rates to 2035.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 proposes extending full CCUS credit rates from 2031 to 2035.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 1 - Clean Economy Investment Tax Credits
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 proposes a five-year extension of full CCUS investment tax credit rates.

commitments.promise: Improve climate disclosure across the economy.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 says the government will work with provinces and territories to improve climate disclosure and align with international standards.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 1 - Mobilising Capital for Transition to Net-Zero
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 announces work with provinces and territories to improve climate disclosure across the economy.

commitments.promise: Raise CAF member pay and support CAF health care.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 proposes $20.4 billion over five years for recruitment, retention, generational pay raises, and CAF health care.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 4 - Rebuilding, Rearming, and Reinvesting in the CAF
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 proposes $20.4 billion over five years for CAF recruitment, retention, pay raises, and health care.

commitments.promise: Establish BOREALIS for defence and security innovation.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 allocates funding to establish BOREALIS under the Defence Industrial Strategy.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 4 - Initial Investments Under the Defence Industrial Strategy
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 proposes $68.2 million over three years to establish BOREALIS.

commitments.promise: Establish a Defence Investment Agency to streamline defence procurement.
commitments.statusRationale: Budget 2025 proposes funding to establish the Defence Investment Agency.

evidence.title: Budget 2025, Chapter 4 - A New Defence Investment Agency
evidence.citation: Budget 2025 proposes $30.8 million over four years and ongoing funding to establish the DIA.
